title: finqa arcibisseh tan egla
intro: ucsub reebuk gubat inki tarmaanah baxxaqsa, uxih baxsa le kibal doorit. Tama muuci numma kee nabiyyih xaqut yan, takkay immay tet cineh yan marih fanah yuduureh. ken aydaadi elle soolem gibdih tan maabitinah numma xayyowtam dubuk amaanat gano rooci cattam madudda.
clues: Anu Yalli doore nabiyyih bugal waara.
Anu yi baqli barseh yan numma eexegeh, takkay immay anu nummaak teetil maamina.
Anu kay Aamanti gano abeh kay ummatta lih gacaanam kee ken catak kaa qagitak.
Anu gersi nabiyyih barra lih galab kak xagem kaadu gano abte, kaafiritte ceelalloh.
Yi xaagi Suurat At-Tahrim addal elle warsennal, nabiyyih fanat yan angaaraw kalalu mali.
Anu Yalli Luutut ummatta bayseh yan waqdi, raqte mara lih cabeh yan waqdi, anu zaalimittellih finqite.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
